title: Billing Office Valuation Rule: Lost-Day Time Value for Delay Goodwill (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Valuation rule.** For the delay goodwill credit on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental, each credited delay day carries the lost-day time value. The lost-day time value is the time charge net of every credit standing on the rental, spread over the days the time charge rightly covers: where a billing-error credit stands on the rental, it is the time charge posted on the final invoice less every standing credit, divided by the rental days; where no billing-error credit stands but a corrected time charge stands, it is that corrected time charge less every standing credit, divided by the days posted on the corrected time charge; otherwise it is the time charge posted on the final invoice less every standing credit, divided by the days posted on the time charge.

Rental days are the whole days between the pickup date and the return date, plus one where the return time as counted is later than the pickup time of day. Every standing credit means every customer credit on the rental, whatever its reason.

## Entries read

The customer's uncovered-days charge on the final invoice and the days posted on it; the uncovered-days charge on a corrected invoice and the days posted on it; every customer credit on the rental, and among them those with reason billing error.

## Valuation table

| Billing-error credit stands | Corrected time charge stands | Lost-day time value |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | Final time charge less every standing credit, divided by the rental days |
| No | Yes | Corrected time charge less every standing credit, divided by the days posted on it |
| No | No | Final time charge less every standing credit, divided by the days posted on it |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- A final time charge of 400.00 USD posted for 9 days on a rental of 8 rental days, with a billing-error credit of 56.08 USD and a discount credit of 34.39 USD standing: 400.00 less 90.47 is 309.53 USD, divided by the 8 rental days, 38.69125 USD.
- No billing-error credit, a corrected time charge of 330.00 USD posted for 8 days and a credit of 33.00 USD: 297.00 USD divided by 8, 37.125 USD.
- Only a final time charge of 400.00 USD for 8 days and a credit of 40.00 USD: 45.00 USD.
